title: Production boot model needs product-owner choice
component_interface: RT1062 boot, QSPI flash and programming
description: The product document prefers a native production flow but leaves native RT1062 boot/update versus Teensy compatibility open. Flash, recovery, fixture, maintenance and external dependency choices differ.

evidence.note: Boot/update model is explicitly open; Teensy compatibility is not automatic.
NXP ROM/flashloader and PJRC MKL02 paths technically characterized; product-owner direction remains open.

R3 disposition: Provisional native NXP boot direction selected for R3. Owner sign-off, exact flash/boot/recovery/security path and production fixture are required before R4 boot-circuit readiness. Earlier R1 criterion remains in repository history. Prior R1 status=open, blocker=R3, closure criterion: Product owner records native or Teensy-compatible direction, expected factory and field update route, service/recovery policy and dependency/licensing disposition; R2 verifies the chosen path against official sources before R3 PASS.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. R4 electrical closure remains blocked; no R5 schematic approval.

Public official evidence and conditional calculations reviewed; closure criterion is not yet satisfied. Current NXP RM Rev 4 / HW Guide Rev 7 access restriction applies to the RT1062 portions. Finding remains blocking, with original history preserved.

evidence.location: section 10, authorized-manual and owner-input closure audit, 2026-09-30
evidence.note: Authorized NXP RM Rev 4 pp.193-214 and HW Guide Rev 7 pp.7-11,14-19 now establish ROM boot modes, FlexSPI A default pads, FCB and boot/reset guidance. Missing-authoritative-evidence flag retired. Exact flash/FCB/fuse-security policy, straps, fixture and reset circuit still prevent closure.

Selected IS25WP064AJBLE 1.8-V 64-Mbit FlexSPI A flash from NXP EVKB reference and explicit 4.7-kohm BOOT_MODE, 10-kohm BT_CFG, 1-kohm fixture override values. MCU_3V3 POR supervisor TPS389030DSER has a bounded threshold; other-rail gate, exact flash command/FCB image, production fuse/security/update policy and bench recovery remain open.

Original R4 boot closure mixed hardware and execution tests. R4 still requires exact flash command/FCB configuration, strap and recovery circuit proof, and hardware-affecting factory/field/security policy. A built and tested boot image plus physical recovery execution stay open with required_by_phase R14 in the project-state R4-A requirement ledger.

V1 hardware policy frozen: unfused native internal boot, no OTP security fuses or OTA path, and powered ROM LPUART1 fixture for factory and field service. NXP CEC Rev 4 Table 22 guaranteed GPIO thresholds and opposing-pull/input leakage limits support the 4.7-kohm/1-kohm static strap corner calculation. Complete FCB, reset, clock and recovery electrical implementation remain open; tested image/recovery remains R14.

NXP RM Rev 4 Tables 9-15/9-18 define the FCB fields and AN12108 treats boot header/image generation as a firmware flow. The selected one-pad 03h profile is deterministic; binary LUT/image validation belongs to R14. Hardware timing, crystal, reset and powered service fixture remain R4-A. NXP HW Guide Rev 7 Tables 8-10 guide UART pullups, boot straps and POR.

closure_criterion: R4-A: prove flash 03h at ROM 30 MHz and voltage compatibility, boot straps, crystal, reset and powered ROM-UART fixture circuit with exact values. Freeze FCB field semantics and recovery/security policy affecting hardware. Generate/check exact FCB bytes and test boot/recovery at R14.
resolved_by: R3 architecture disposition; later closure required
resolution: Provisional native NXP boot direction selected for R3. Owner sign-off, exact flash/boot/recovery/security path and production fixture are required before R4 boot-circuit readiness.
